Package com.eco.bio7.simulation

package com.eco.bio7.simulation
The simulation API of Bio7: simulation models in Java which run live in Bio7 and can be exported as interactive HTML pages (the model is translated to JavaScript and runs in the web browser with the same results).

A model extends one of the model classes and implements init() (the start state) and step() (one time step):

  • GridModel: a grid of cells with integer states (ImageJ)
  • ValueGridModel: a grid of double values with a color map (ImageJ)
  • AgentModel: agents in a 3D box (the 3D view)
  • GeoGridModel: a georeferenced grid with data read by GDAL (ImageJ, the WorldWind globe, a map in the HTML page)
  • GeoAgentModel: agents on the Earth (the WorldWind globe, a map in the HTML page)
Fields with the annotation Param are settings (sliders, number fields, checkboxes, choices, text fields), methods with Action are buttons. The methods of all models (random numbers, mathematics, statistics, differential equations, charts, parallel random numbers) are inherited from Simulation.

All models can show images (loadImage, drawImage, Agent.image), animated 3D models of glTF (loadModel, Agent.model, Agent.animation; Gltf), shapes drawn in each step (Shape: drawLine, drawPath, drawPolygon, drawCircle, drawRect, drawText) and several charts (ChartData: chart, chartXY, chartBars; the Charts view of Bio7). The mathematical functions (vectors, matrices, regression, quantiles, the normal distribution, noise) give the same results in Bio7 and in the HTML page. The first setup arranges the views in the Custom perspective: the settings on the left, the editor above the display of the model and the charts beside the display.

The wizard "Bio7 Simulation Project" creates a model (in Java, Python or R), "Export Simulation as HTML..." (the menu of the Play/Pause button, the Settings view or the context menu of the Java and R editors) exports it (SimulationExport). The examples are in the project Bio7_Java_Examples (packages simulation and simulation.api).

Python and R: the same models can be written as scripts with the module bio7sim of the embedded Python (from bio7sim import *, numpy arrays) or the functions of bio7sim of the embedded R (grid_model(), matrices and data frames). simulation(model) at the end of the script starts a Java model of the same kind (ScriptSimulation): the same displays (ImageJ, the 3D view, the WorldWind globe), the same settings, the same geospatial data of GDAL. The HTML export (ScriptExport) runs the script in the web browser with Pyodide or webR (loaded from the internet) with the same results. The examples are in the project Bio7_Script_Examples (folders Python/Simulation and R_Simulation).

  • Class
    Description
    Action
    Marks a method of a simulation model (public, without parameters) as an action: a button in the settings of Bio7 and of the HTML export (e.g., "Add a glider").
    Agent
    An agent of an AgentModel: a position (x, y, z in the units of the box of the model, z is the height) and an optional color (e.g., "#d62728", null: the color of the model).
    AgentModel<A extends Agent>
    A simulation of agents in a box (e.g., a swarm): the agents (subclasses of Agent) are displayed as spheres in the 3D view of Bio7 (and in the 3D view of the HTML export).
    ChartData
    A chart of a model: a line chart of values over the steps (chart), an XY chart (chartXY, e.g., a phase plot) or a bar chart (chartBars, replaced in each call).
    GeoAgent
    An agent of a GeoAgentModel: a geographic position (longitude and latitude in degrees, WGS84), a color (e.g., "#d62728", null: the color of the model), a size (the radius of the point in pixels, 0: the size of the model), an optional label, an altitude and a heading (for the 3D shapes on the WorldWind globe).
    GeoAgentModel<A extends GeoAgent>
    A simulation of agents on the Earth (e.g., migrating animals, cities in an epidemic, ships): the agents (GeoAgent) have a longitude and a latitude and are displayed as points on the WorldWind globe of Bio7 (the WorldWind perspective is opened) and on a map in the HTML export (online base maps).
    GeoGridModel
    A simulation on a georeferenced grid (a geospatial model, e.g., a wildfire on a terrain, a runoff or a species dispersal): the grid and its data layers are read with GDAL in Bio7 (rasters and vectors in any format of GDAL, e.g., GeoTIFF, GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoJSON) and resampled or rasterized to the cells.
    Gltf
    A 3D model of glTF 2.0 (.glb or .gltf): the meshes (triangles with normals, texture coordinates, the base color and the texture of the material), the nodes, the skins and the animations (translation, rotation and scale of the nodes; linear, step and cubic spline interpolation).
    Gltf.Mesh
    A mesh of a pose: the triangles and the material.
    GridModel
    A simulation on a grid of cells (e.g., a cellular automaton like the Game of Life): the cells have integer states which are displayed with the colors of the palette in an ImageJ image (and in the 2D view of the HTML export).
    JavaToJs
    Translates a simulation model (a subclass of GridModel, ValueGridModel or AgentModel) from Java to JavaScript for the HTML export.
    JavaToJs.ActionInfo
    An action of the model (a method with the annotation Action): a button.
    JavaToJs.ParamInfo
    A setting of the model (a field with the annotation Param).
    Param
    Marks a field of a simulation model as a setting: the HTML export shows it as a control (a slider with min and max, else a number field, a checkbox for a boolean, a choice with options, else a text field).
    ScriptExport
    The HTML export of a simulation model of Python or R: the page runs the same script in the web browser, Python with Pyodide (Python and numpy in WebAssembly), R with webR (R in WebAssembly).
    ScriptSimulation
    Simulation models written in Python or R (the modules bio7sim of Python and R).
    ScriptSimulation.Agents
    Agents in a 3D box of a script.
    ScriptSimulation.GeoAgents
    Agents on the Earth of a script.
    ScriptSimulation.GeoGrid
    A geospatial grid of a script (the data is loaded by load() of the script with the GDAL of Bio7).
    ScriptSimulation.Grid
    A grid with integer states of a script.
    ScriptSimulation.Host
    A Java model of a script (the proxies of the kinds).
    ScriptSimulation.Script
    The script of a model: the description, the interpreter and a thread for the calls of the user interface.
    ScriptSimulation.Spec
    The description of a script model (sent by simulation(model) of the script).
    ScriptSimulation.Values
    A grid with double values of a script.
    Shape
    A shape drawn by a model in a time step (drawLine, drawPath, drawPolygon, drawCircle, drawRect, drawText, drawImage, drawLine3 of Simulation).
    SimRandom
    A small seeded random number generator (mulberry32) with the same numbers in Java and in JavaScript (the HTML export uses the same algorithm): a simulation started with the same seed gives the same results in Bio7 and in the web browser.
    Simulation
    The base class of the simulation models of the simulation API (see GridModel, ValueGridModel and AgentModel).
    Simulation.Derivatives
    The derivatives of a system of differential equations: dy/dt = f(t, y).
    SimulationExport
    Exports a simulation model of the simulation API (a Java source file of a subclass of GridModel or AgentModel) as an interactive HTML page: the model is translated to JavaScript (JavaToJs), runs with the JavaScript version of the API and is displayed with the page of HtmlSimulation (a 2D grid or a 3D view, the settings of the Param fields, Play/Pause, Step, Reset, the speed and a chart).
    SimulationExport.Options
    The options of the page.
    SimulationExport.Result
    The result of a translation: the page or the errors.
    SimulationSettings
    The settings of a simulation model in Bio7: a custom view ("Settings") with a control for each field with the annotation Param and a button for each method with the annotation Action (the same controls as the HTML export, below the headings of their groups).
    ValueGridModel
    A simulation on a grid of values (e.g., a diffusion or a reaction-diffusion model): each cell has a double value which is displayed with a color map from min to max in an ImageJ image (and in the 2D view of the HTML export).
